top_choice_rationale: P001 (Mircea Cărtărescu, sole credited writer) is preferred on literary grounds under the common criteria. As publicly described, Blinding and Solenoid show an unmistakable voice that joins bodily and mnemonic material to large recursive structures in long, densely patterned prose. The project appears cumulative across verse and prose rather than a single peak, and attribution is unambiguous. Serious reservations remain, and I record them rather than discount them. Sentence-level achievement in Romanian can be judged only through translation and critical report. Sustained ambition has not been shown to equal sustained quality beyond the best-known novels. Whether the inward, maximalist mode gives breadth of significance is unresolved. The round-2 agreement on this laureate is not an independent check, since all files rest on the same limited evidence. These reservations do not outweigh the case, and the wording I support (prose rooted in a lyric imagination, no lineage or lifetime claims) asserts no more than the evidence supports. P000 is ranked last because a defensible, single-writer award is available.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my own fiction and Selma Lagerlöf biography are context only, not evidence of a preference, and my 2024 Nobel Museum interview concerned a different laureate and was given on behalf of the committee
